title: Orthogonality Property of Constant-Magnitude Vectors
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For r(t) = <3 cos(2t), 3 sin(2t), 4>, verify that |r(t)| is constant and r(t) . r'(t) = 0 for all t.

steps.title: Calculate Magnitude of r(t)
steps.explanation: The norm is constant and independent of t.

steps.title: Compute Velocity Vector r'(t)
steps.explanation: Differentiate each component using chain rule.

steps.title: Evaluate r(t) . r'(t)
steps.explanation: The terms cancel identically, proving orthogonality.
steps.why: Verifying that derivative is perpendicular to position on sphere.
